title: FieldValidationErrorResponse
description: 400 body for a submit rejected by validation (HEL-1087 design.md D5). `message` is kept so `extractErrorMessage` and every existing client-side error-message reader keep working unchanged; `fieldErrors` is the new, structured addition a form can associate per control.

reason.description: One of FormSubmission.buildRow's pinned reasons or DatasetRowValidator's 'expected <type>, got <kind>' template.
